metadata.description:
In this special episode of The Tribal Kitchen, we dive into the serene waters and vibrant flavors of tribal life! Watch as we follow the journey from catching fresh fish straight from the river to cooking it in a rich, aromatic mustard curry — a recipe passed down through generations.

 #TribalKitchen #FreshCatch #MustardfishCurry #TribalFood
